projectDescription: Bridge is a hosted AI integration platform that connects Claude, Gemini, or any MCP-compatible AI directly to your business tools — ClickUp, Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar, Shopify, and more — so you can get work done in plain English.
keyFeatures: Command Center — chat-driven task execution in plain English across all connected tools
MCP endpoint — connect Claude or Gemini directly to Bridge via the Model Context Protocol
Plays Library — pre-built instruction sets for common workflows (transcript-to-tasks, client onboarding, standups)
Missions — save multi-step workflows and replay them with one click
10+ business tool connectors: ClickUp, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Slack, Shopify, HubSpot, Guru, and more
Organization & team management with role-based access (owner, admin, member)
Tiered billing plans: Free, Individual, Team, and Agency
publicApiSurface: POST /api/command/stream — stream an AI-powered command execution (SSE)
POST /api/command/execute — execute a command and receive a JSON response
GET /api/connectors — list all connectors and their connection status
GET /api/profile — get the authenticated user's profile
POST /api/org/members/invite — invite a member to the organization
POST /api/billing/portal — open the Stripe billing portal
/mcp — MCP protocol endpoint for Claude/Gemini integration
